arguments.content: Early in this ChatGPT thread, Anthony uploaded the SAD v1.0 VDAC1 Gate-Opening Therapeutic Stack for MSS colorectal cancer. ChatGPT’s review judged the statin-mediated gate-opening architecture stronger than the earlier TSPO→mitophagy→CBD sequence, especially because it let the old architecture die and specified falsification points. It also flagged protocol-level issues: HCT116 was listed as MSS CRC, but public cell-line references identify HCT116 as MSI-high/microsatellite instable, so it should not carry the MSS validation role alone; and Experiment 2’s kill condition appeared inverted because absence of cGAS-STING activation in VDAC1-KO cells would support VDAC1 dependence rather than kill it. Future instances should retrieve this before using HCT116 as an MSS line or before reproducing the SAD’s Experiment 2 kill logic.
